attributes: Opportunity Type, Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Owner Name
goal: Monitor sales pipeline generation and opportunity progression to track weekly and cumulative performance of deal creation across different sales stages and teams.
user_context: Sales operations managers and revenue operations teams use this dashboard during weekly planning meetings to monitor pipeline generation performance by tracking M1, S0, and S1 stage opportunity creation counts and ACV values across different time periods, comparing individual contributor performance by creator name, owner, and source, analyzing team-level productivity across different creator profiles (SDR, AE, etc.) and opportunity types (new customer vs expansion), identifying trends in opportunity progression by examining stage distribution of deals created weeks ago, and drilling down into detailed deal lists to investigate specific opportunities that may need attention or follow-up action.
